meta.name: cavecrew
meta.description: When to delegate to `cavecrew-investigator` (locate code), `cavecrew-builder` (1-2 file edit) or `cavecrew-reviewer` (diff review) instead of working inline or using `Explore`. Their output is compressed, so main context lasts longer.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 按需分派子代理处理代码定位、修改与审查
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你常用 AI 写代码,想通过子代理分工节省上下文。
copy.tagline_en: Delegate to sub-agents for code search, edits, and reviews to save context.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you code with AI and want to manage context by delegating tasks to sub-agents.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会把「定位代码」「改 1-2 个文件」「审查 diff」这三类活交给三个 cavecrew 子代理去做。它们返回的是压缩过的结构化结果，所以主对话的上下文消耗更少、能撑更久。
howto.when: 当你要查某处定义或调用位置、做 ≤2 个文件的小改动、或审查 diff 时，会交给对应子代理；跨多文件重构、想要详细分析或只要一句话答案时，留在主线程。

say.text: 帮我找一下 parseConfig 在哪定义、哪些地方调用它
把 src/api.ts:42 改成用新的 client，只改这一个文件
审查当前分支的 diff，只看 bug

howto.what_en: After installing, Claude delegates locating code, 1-2 file edits, and diff reviews to three cavecrew subagents. Their tool results are compressed, so main context shrinks per delegation and lasts longer.
howto.when_en: Use it to locate a definition or caller, make a small edit within 1-2 files, or review a diff. For multi-file refactors or prose-style analysis, stay on the main thread.

say_en.text: Find where parseConfig is defined and every place it's called.
say_en.note: Spawns cavecrew-investigator; returns a path:line list

say_en.text: Change src/api.ts:42 to use the new client; just this one file.
say_en.note: Hands off to cavecrew-builder with a verified summary

say_en.text: Review the current branch diff for bugs only.
say_en.note: cavecrew-reviewer returns findings sorted by line
